statement: VLP numerics v2 conformance suite (add_low_rank_columns), frozen after independent reproduction: an evaluator written from SPEC.md and the frozen v1 SPEC.md alone reproduced all 91 cases blind, and the SG-EDIT-1 review accepted the operand-level written rule and the NaN-inside-J precondition. An implementation gate for LARQL's column-scoped additive structured op and its independent verifier. v1 is unchanged.

reviewed_text.difference_from_frozen: the status paragraph at the top of SPEC.md and the status line in generate.py's docstring only; no rule, case or vector changed

independent_reproduction.limits: one evaluator of the same model family in a fresh context; the spec was revised in response to it; the two vectors added after its first report (ref-column-negative, ref-base-word-count) are not independent predictions. See independent/HISTORY.md.
